Services Offered By Our ERP Developers

ERP Implementation Services

Mobilunity’s developers will help you overcome the challenges of implementing any ERP system. With thorough planning, building, and deployment of a comprehensive ERP, companies get a business-boosting solution. When you hire ERP experts from us, they use proven approaches and advanced technologies to provide your business  with the top-quality resource management tools.

ERP Customization Services

Engage professional ERP developers to tailor your ERP system and effectively specific business requirements. Our developers analyze your workflows and configure the software to optimize processes, enhance user experience, and maximize productivity. From custom UI/UX design to workflow automation, we ensure your system aligns perfectly with your operational needs.

ERP Module Development

An ERP system consists of several modules — functionality packs supporting the operations of a separate department. Once you need to develop from scratch or fine-tune a module for human resources, mergers and acquisitions, financial management, and any other industry-specific activities – our best ERP software development engineers can help you drive meaningful outcomes.

ERP Migration Solutions

Given that information is one of the leading business assets, transferring it to other systems effectively and securely is a very important thing. When you hire ERP programmers with us, they will work out a detailed plan to move your client, partner, sales, financial, legal, and other data to the new ERP platform. They’ll migrate your information within deadlines without redundancy, inconsistency, or loss.

ERP Mobile Application Development

Extend the capabilities of your ERP system with custom mobile applications. When you hire ERP developers with us, they design and develop mobile apps tailored to your specific needs, enabling remote access, real-time updates, and enhanced user experience. Empower your workforce with mobile ERP application solutions that boost productivity and facilitate seamless collaboration anytime, anywhere.

ERP AI and Automation

Drive efficiency and innovation with custom ERP AI and automation solutions. Our developers integrate artificial intelligence and machine learning into your ERP system to automate repetitive tasks, optimize workflows, and improve decision-making. From predictive maintenance to intelligent data analysis, AI-driven custom solutions developed by our experts empower you to stay agile and reduce costs.

ERP Performance Optimization

Finding the gaps between your expectations, available tools, and industry best practices is meticulous work our experienced ERP software developers do. These professionals will delve deep into your operational requirements and check if your ERP module meets them. They’ll help you explore factors impacting your performance and offer an update strategy or effective add-on implementation.

Flexible ERP Developer

Whether you need an audit of your current ERP platform or plan to start using one, our developers will advise on optimized solutions. The proven experts you find at Mobilunity have already solved your problem before. They’ll explore your needs, identify crucial functionalities, find the room for potential improvement & future updates, and customize the solution to your processes.

ERP Support and Maintenance

Our professional ERP developers can help you ensure your system operates smoothly. Providing comprehensive support and proactive monitoring, we will back your software development project with regular updates and troubleshooting. Eventually, this can contribute to minimizing downtime, securing business risks, and keeping your software running at peak performance without disruptions.

ERP Extension and Plugin Development

Sometimes, core ERP modules won’t be enough for a business. You may additionally need a security module, a customer relationship tool, an e-commerce package, data mining functionalities, or other industry-specific features to drive your project growth. That’s when an ERP programmer will help you develop customized extensions with third-party tools you need to integrate with.

{cooperation models}

Choose Your Cooperation Model

Dedicated ERP Developers

Large-volume projects require a dedicated team of ERP software developers. This plan assumes we build your team of full-time programmers and handle back-office tasks for them. You get functional control over your team through your or our PM. We ensure transparency, regular communication, and confidentiality of our cooperation. You pay a monthly fixed-fee invoice.

Hire Dedicated ERP Developer

FLEX ERP Developers

Small projects often require engaging one flexible part-time software developer. This format works better for low-volume work, limited budgets, and flexible deadlines. Engage developers only when you need them and pay only for the hours worked. So, you can get advice from skilled experts to improve or build your solution cost-effectively.

ERP Software Solutions Provided by Our Developers

Oracle NetSuite ERP

Oracle NetSuite is one of the best-in-class cloud-based ERP solutions. It allows you to monitor inventories, control financial activities, run customer support, and many more. Hire NetSuite ERP developers to access informative dashboards from anywhere and gain a 360-degree visibility. With this platform, you can store your data securely and have it timely updated for all users.

Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP

Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP’s embedded AI enables predictive planning to deliver forecasts with less bias and deviations With an Oracle Cloud ERP developer, you’ll be able to try more performing business approaches and adjust new models through AI-driven insights. The platform’s digital assistants will allow you to communicate with the software using simple language and get important notifications.

Dynamics 365/NAV ERP

Business agility and optimized performance are only a couple of aspects an ERP can improve. A Microsoft Dynamics ERP developer available for hire will bring all your corporate processes together, ensuring this transition will pay off. However, switching to the new system doesn’t mean abandoning your current tools. An implementation expert will make them work together for your future growth.

SAP ERP

Advanced analytics and digital assistants are key benefits of the SAP ERP solution. Let our SAP ERP developer get the most out of this cloud-based, secure, and flexible instrument for you. Leverage this powerful, fast-deploying, and scalable platform for your asset management, manufacturing, and finance teams. Streamline the operations of your supply chain, procurement, R&D, and engineering departments.

Tryton ERP

The open-source Tryton software is a perfect solution for companies of any size / capacity due to its modular nature, high versatility, and scalability. You can use its cloud, on-premises, or hybrid version. A Tryton ERP developer will help you improve data accuracy, automate routine tasks, and greatly speed up decision-making. The software is available on laptops, desktops, and mobiles.

Odoo (Formerly OpenERP)

Odoo is a state-of-the-art open-source ERP system consisting of multiple apps. From website building to Product Lifecycle Management, this solution will best suit small and midsize businesses. Manufacturing, distribution, service, marketing, training, R&D, IT, accounting companies, and retailers use this platform. An Odoo ERP developer will make this low-cost and integration-friendly work for you.

Decide whether to hire a qualified ERP expert part-time or to build a dedicated team from ground zero. Think about your project duration and estimate the number of software developers, based on the scope of your ERP project.

Fill in the web form, list your requirements and business expectations. We’ll come back to discuss the scope of assistance you need to build your ERP product, and advise on optimal team composition.

We’ll send you calculations of approximate costs to create an ERP team or single hire. This covers recruiting, onboarding, and maintaining your professional ERP project developers and coders.

{04}

Interviewing Candidates

We’ll complete pre-screening and interview the shortlisted talents. We verify the most qualified and strong ERP consulting candidates. You can engage our experts for tech interviews and only run top-level meetings.

{05}

Start Your Cooperation

When you find ERP developers for hire and decide who is going to join your project, we handle all the paperwork (contract, NDA agreement, etc. ) and initiate onboarding. Now you can immediately start working.

FAQs On Hiring Top ERP Developers

Why do I need to hire an expert ERP developer?

Once you decide to implement an ERP system, an ERP engineer will set this solution up for you. This specialist will match the features of your system with your expectations. They’ll connect your existing software with new tools to grow performance. A programmer will help you centralize the information and make it accessible to all ERP users.

Can assistance be provided for developer technical interviews?

Certainly, as a tech talent company with over 14 years in business, we offer assistance with ERP developer technical interviews as part of our specialized services for an extra fee. We organize technical discussions with top experts, ideal for teams that lack this specific capability. You’ll receive a thorough analysis and feedback from the interviewer, helping you understand the candidate’s potential impact on your projects.

What are the top skills of experienced ERP developers?

Look for dedicated developers with experience implementing Oracle, SAP, and Microsoft Dynamics ERPs. Those engineers have deep knowledge of ERP implementation, customization, deployment, and data migration. With such an expert, you’ll ensure your data is secured and the system is performant and well-maintained.

What’s the cost to hire remote ERP developers?

The average cost per programmer can be $70,000-$150,000 per year. However, this number will depend on the experience and location of your engineer and the project scope. For instance, US-based developers get around $95,752 annually, while their Ukrainian colleagues earn between $18,000 and $36,000.

What will I get if I hire ERP developers with Mobilunity?

We’ve been in the IT market for over 14 years, and our recruiters have proven approaches to searching and engaging qualified engineers. Also, we have access to global talent pools and a vast professional network to identify your best-fit candidate quickly. Finally, we offer competitive prices, as we can hire top-skilled developers in the world’s leading IT hubs.

How do you ensure the quality of the developers you provide?

At Mobilunity, we follow a rigorous recruitment process to ensure we provide only top-tier developers. This includes thorough screening, technical assessments, and multiple rounds of interviews to evaluate the candidates’ skills, experience, and cultural fit. We also verify their past work and references.

Can your developers work with our existing systems and tools?

Yes, they are highly adaptable and experienced with a variety of systems and tools, including the most common ones. They can seamlessly integrate new solutions with your existing infrastructure, ensuring minimal disruption to your operations. Our developers are proficient in multiple platforms, databases, as well as programming languages.

What industries do your enterprise resource planning developers have experience in?

Our developers have extensive experience across various industries, including manufacturing, finance, healthcare, retail, logistics, and more. This diverse expertise enables them to understand the unique challenges and requirements of different sectors, ensuring they can deliver tailored ERP solutions that meet your specific business needs.

What kind of support can I expect after the enterprise resource planning system is implemented?

Mobilunity offers comprehensive post-implementation support to ensure your system runs smoothly. This includes regular updates, troubleshooting, and continuous monitoring to address any issues that arise. Our support services are designed to minimize downtime and optimize the performance of your system, ensuring long-term success.

How long does it take for you to hire an ERP developer, and when will I see benefits from my solution?

5-8 weeks usually pass between our first call and the onboarding of your freelance ERP developers. However, you can get the first results from your solution between 3-4 weeks and 2-3 months. This timeframe will depend on the current workflow analysis and the scope of required customizations and integrations.
